transcript.answer: Yes. Issue #498 in re-cinq/Otto, "Stop the tool-budget message promising a follow-up while no escalation destination exists", is open. It is labelled type:bug, priority:medium and lore:blocked. `TOOL_BUDGET_MESSAGE_DA` (from #151, shipped in #439) ends with "En kollega vil følge op på din henvendelse." (a colleague will follow up). With no escalation destination configured, nobody is notified, so the promise is empty. The re:cinq test environment is set up this way because KU-14 is open. FR-017 forbids other kinds of promise (phone number, email, opening hours, persona name) but not a follow-up, so its test still passes. The issue is blocked on a decision about what the message may promise (KU-14) and on a Danish speaker for any new wording (KU-15). PR #495 also flagged the problem.

judgements.reason: The answer identifies open issue #498 labelled lore:blocked, explains that the follow-up message notifies nobody when no escalation destination is configured, and notes it is blocked on KU-14 and a Danish speaker (KU-15).
